eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Jackson, OR; at 4:45 PM on AUG 13, 2026 Effective until 10:45 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Jackson County Sheriff's Office has issued a Level 2 BE SET to evacuate for zone JAC-052-A near north of I5 west of Foothill blvd to Josephine Co border due to I5 Mile Marker 51 Fire. Monitor local government sources for evacuation and incident updates
